text: 金十数据7月14日讯，7月14日，财政部、应急管理部紧急预拨4.3亿元中央自然灾害救灾资金，支持广西、浙江、河北、辽宁、天津、黑龙江、江苏、安徽、江西、四川等10省（区、市）开展防汛防台风应急抢险救灾工作。其中，一是在前期预拨1.9亿元基础上，追加预拨1.5亿元，支持广西继续重点做好受灾群众安置、过渡期生活救助以及倒损民房修复等工作，推动灾区尽快恢复正常生产生活秩序；二是预拨2.8亿元，支持其余9省（市）统筹做好搜救转移安置受灾人员、排危除险等应急处置、开展次生灾害隐患排查和应急整治等，最大限度减少灾害损失。
text_en: Jin Shi Data, July 14 - On July 14, the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management urgently allocated 430 million yuan in central natural disaster relief funds to support 10 provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities), including Guangxi, Zhejiang, Hebei, Liaoning, Tianjin, Heilongjiang, Jiangsu, Anhui, Jiangxi, and Sichuan, in carrying out flood prevention, typhoon prevention, and emergency rescue and relief efforts. Among them: first, on the basis of an earlier 190 million yuan allocation, an additional 150 million yuan was allocated to support Guangxi in continuing to focus on resettling affected people, providing transitional living assistance, and repairing damaged or collapsed houses, to help the disaster area restore normal production and living order as soon as possible; second, 280 million yuan was allocated to support the other nine provinces (cities) in coordinating search, rescue, relocation, and resettlement of affected people, emergency response such as hazard removal and risk elimination, and conducting inspections and emergency remediation of secondary disaster risks, to minimize disaster losses.
